#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n_input;
    cin >> n_input;
    int n = n_input * 2;

    // Initialize 3D DP array: dimensions (n+1) x (n+1) x 2
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(n + 1, vector<vector<int>>(n + 1, vector<int>(2, 0)));

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int h = 0; h <= i; h++) {
            if ((i - h) % 2 != 0) {
                continue;
            }
            if (h + 1 <= i - 1) {
                // dp[i][h][0]
                int val0 = 0;
                if (i - 1 >= 0 && h + 1 <= n && 1 <= n) {
                    val0 = (dp[i - 1][h + 1][1] + 1) % MOD;
                }
                // dp[i][h][1]
                int val1 = 0;
                if (i - 1 >= 0 && h + 1 <= n && 0 <= n) {
                    val1 = dp[i - 1][h + 1][0];
                }
                if (h > 0) {
                    if (i - 1 >= 0 && h - 1 >= 0 && 0 <= n) {
                        val0 = (val0 + dp[i - 1][h - 1][0]) % MOD;
                        val1 = (val1 + dp[i - 1][h - 1][0]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                dp[i][h][0] = val0;
                dp[i][h][1] = val1;
            } else {
                // When (i - h) % 2 == 0 and h + 1 > i - 1
                int val0 = 0;
                int val1 = 0;
                if (i - 1 >= 0 && h - 1 >= 0 && 1 <= n && 0 <= n) {
                    val0 = (dp[i - 1][h - 1][1] + 0) % MOD; // +1 in original code, but here it's 0 because no addition
                    val1 = dp[i - 1][h - 1][0];
                }
                dp[i][h][0] = val0;
                dp[i][h][1] = val1;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << dp[n][0][0] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
